per_hop.query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT campus_name) 
   FROM universities 
   WHERE university_name = (SELECT university_name 
                            FROM professors 
                            WHERE name = 'Richard J. Wood' AND department = 'Mathematics' AND state = 'Connecticut')) AS wood_university_campuses,
  
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT campus_name) 
   FROM universities 
   WHERE university_name = 'California State Polytechnic University, Pomona') AS cal_poly_pomona_campuses;
